Deterministic evaluation and exact money

A source-linked technical walkthrough. Trace the flow, explain the boundary, then test the failure path.

After this session, you can:
  • Trace one evaluation
  • Explain exact decimal handling
  • Prove fail-closed behavior

Technical flow

1. Canonical request

The gateway sends a decision name, tenant-bound bundle identity and validated facts. The evaluator performs no lookup: all permitted inputs are present in the request and bundle.

2. Exact and reproducible

Decimal values use rust_decimal and serialized strings. Stable ordering and canonical output ensure the same accepted input and bundle produce byte-identical decision evidence.

3. Restrictive errors

Missing facts, invalid decimals, unsupported operations, contract mismatch and internal errors cannot fall through to approve or allow. Business decisions refer; authority and guardrail decisions deny or require human review as defined by contract.
